uplink.description: Status report, no vibration on either gang (upstream example input)
uplink._note: Upstream Status report input (status1=0, status2=0). Battery byte 30 (0x1e) => 3.0 V, no low-battery flag. Both gangs idle -> both entries detected false, roll-up count 0; both entries are still emitted (this format defines no disconnected-gang sentinel). expected.data authored here from reference/upstream-codec.js wire semantics, NOT copied from upstream normalizeUplink.

uplink.description: Synthetic: gang0 detecting vibration, gang1 idle
uplink._note: status1=1 (gang0 vibrating), status2=0 (gang1 idle). The positions DIFFER - the per-position truth the old top-level either-gang OR could not express. `motion` resolves through the entries; the top-level roll-up count is 1.

uplink.description: Synthetic: gang0 idle, gang1 detecting vibration
uplink._note: The inverse per-position states from the previous vector at the same roll-up count of 1, so a swapped-entry bug (status1 read into gang1) fails exactly one of the two vectors.

uplink.description: Synthetic: both gangs detecting vibration, low battery flagged
uplink._note: Battery byte 158 (0x9e): high bit 0x80 set -> lowBattery true; lower 7 bits 0x1e=30 => 3.0 V. status1=1, status2=1 -> both gangs detecting, roll-up count 2. battery/lowBattery are whole-device readings and stay top-level, outside the channels[] entries.

uplink.description: Startup/device-info frame carries no measurement (upstream example input)
uplink._note: reportType byte 0x00 is the SW/HW version + datecode startup frame; no measurement, reported as an error.

uplink.description: Config response on fPort 7 carries no measurement
uplink._note: fPort 7 is config request/response (ConfigReportRsp); not a data report.
